translationRepairs: You squandered grain to move the gods, you pried with reed stalks for omens; you spurned the spirit's warning— and threw your life into the shallows!
You squandered grain to move the gods, you pried with reed stalks for omens; you spurned Ling Fen's counsel and would not follow— and threw your life into the shallows!

Focus Chinese has 違靈氛而不從: the named diviner Ling Fen and the refusal to follow. Idiomatic 'the spirit's warning' erases that name; the proposed wording restores both 靈氛 and 而不從 without adding unsupported sense.
Clear and turbid, high and low notes answer one another like masters tuning a flawless lute.
Clear and turbid, high and low notes answer one another like Kui and Boya tuning a flawless lute.
Chinese 若夔、牙之調琴 names the musicians Kui and Ya (Boya). Replacing generic 'masters' with those names corrects a real omission; the rest of the idiomatic line is unchanged.
The ancient master-builders lay down their tools; the surveyor drops his cord and square.
Ban and Chui cast aside their adze and chisel; Wang Er casts aside his hook and line.
Chinese names 般、倕 and 王爾 with their tools 剞厥 and 鉤繩. The idiomatic generics drop those persons; Ban, Chui, and Wang Er with adze, chisel, hook, and line match the source.
Xihe guides the day; the groom holds the reins; winds lash; spirits seem to race alongside.
Xihe guides the day; Yanlun holds the reins; winds lash; spirits seem to race alongside.
Chinese pairs 羲和司日 with 顏倫奉輿. Idiomatic 'the groom' erases Yanlun; naming him restores the parallel personal reference without inventing new content.
They drift Pengli, gaze toward Shun's land, tally night-shining pearls, split moon-pearls, summon river goddesses, feast the drowned poets' shades.
They drift Pengli, gaze toward Shun's land, tally night-shining pearls, split moon-pearls, whip Lady Fu of the Luo, and feast Qu Yuan and Peng-Xu.

Chinese has 鞭洛水之虙妃，餉屈原與彭胥: whip Lady Fu of the Luo and feast Qu Yuan and Peng-Xu. Idiomatic 'summon river goddesses' and 'drowned poets' shades' invent paraphrase and drop those names and the whipping; the proposal restores them accurately.
